items.exampleEn: A small insect crawled across my notebook.
items.exampleZh: 一隻小蟲爬過我的筆記本。

items.exampleEn: The museum's latest acquisition is a painting from 1890.
items.exampleZh: 博物館最新購得的收藏是一幅 1890 年的畫作。

items.exampleEn: The police car drove off in pursuit of the stolen motorbike.
items.exampleZh: 警車開走去追那輛被偷的機車。

items.exampleEn: Someone left a banana peel on the stairs.
items.exampleZh: 有人把香蕉皮丟在樓梯上。

items.exampleEn: She flipped the light switch, but nothing happened.
items.exampleZh: 她按了電燈開關，但什麼反應都沒有。

items.exampleEn: The sun vanished behind the clouds.
He chopped wood for the fireplace.
The plane began to descend toward the airport.

items.sentenceEn: The company's acquisition of a smaller rival was announced on Monday.
items.sentenceZh: 那家公司在星期一宣佈收購一家較小的對手。

items.audioEn: Be careful as you descend the stairs; the lights are broken.
items.audioZh: 下樓梯時小心點，燈壞了。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要對方下樓梯小心？
options: The steps are wet from the rain
It is very late at night
Someone is coming up the stairs
It is too dark to see well

items.sentenceEn: The magician waved his hand, and the coin vanished.
items.sentenceZh: 魔術師揮了一下手，硬幣就不見了。

items.sentenceEn: Babies usually start to crawl before they can walk.
items.sentenceZh: 嬰兒通常在會走路之前就開始爬了。

items.stemEn: Please ____ the stickers off the window carefully.
items.stemZh: 請小心地把窗戶上的貼紙撕下來。

items.stemEn: He moved to Paris in ____ of his dream to become a chef.
items.stemZh: 他為了追求成為廚師的夢想搬到巴黎。

items.passageEn: Every Sunday, my father and I cook dinner together. Last week, he taught me how to make potato pancakes. First, I peeled the potatoes and chopped two onions while he heated the pan. He can flip a pancake high in the air and catch it again, which always makes me laugh. My baby brother crawled into the kitchen to watch us, and our cat descended the stairs as soon as it smelled the food. My father also had an innovative idea: adding a little cheese. The first pancakes vanished from the plate within minutes. Cooking is his favorite pursuit outside work.
items.passageZh: 每個星期天，我和爸爸都會一起做晚餐。上週，他教我做馬鈴薯煎餅。首先，我削了馬鈴薯的皮，又切了兩顆洋蔥，他則把鍋子加熱。他能把煎餅拋得高高的再接住，每次都讓我笑出來。還在學爬的弟弟爬進廚房看我們，我們家的貓一聞到食物的味道就下樓來了。爸爸還有個很有創意的點子：加一點起司。第一批煎餅幾分鐘內就從盤子上消失了。做菜是他工作以外最喜歡的嗜好。

questions.questionZh: 爸爸翻煎餅時會怎麼做？
options: 把煎餅拋到空中再接住
因為火太大全部燒焦了

items.promptZh: 牆上的舊油漆開始剝落了。
referenceEn: The old paint on the wall is starting to peel.
The old paint on the wall has begun to peel.
rubricZh: peel 的用法，例如 is starting to peel、has begun to peel 等
時態合理（例如 is starting、has begun 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 flip 造一個句子，說說你會翻動或翻轉什麼東西（例如硬幣、書頁）。
referenceEn: I flip a coin when I can't decide what to eat.
I flipped through a magazine while I was waiting for the bus.
rubricZh: flip 的用法，例如 flip a coin、flip through a magazine 等
時態配合內容（例如 flip、flipped 等）
